items.event_time_ist: Oct 19, 2026 (CNN report; strike planning over recent weeks)
items.title: CNN: US military drew up new Iran strike plans incl. possible MOAB use; Iran preparing for further war
items.summary: CNN reported Oct 19 (multiple US officials, original reporting) that the US military has developed new strike plans including potentially using the GBU-43/B 'mother of all bombs' against Iranian energy infrastructure and nuclear sites if Trump orders combat to resume either before or after the Nov 3 midterms; White House advisers told CNN privately they are unsure Trump's no-strikes-before-midterms pledge is definitive. Iran is signaling a more offensive doctrine — Revolutionary Guards accounts reported exercises launching 30 ballistic missiles in one go, and commanders warned of possible pre-emptive strikes and wider targets (undersea cables, AI data centers, regional oil/gas facilities). Separately, the US moved all long-range bombers out of the UK earlier this month after an unspecified new threat, and the UK arrested individuals over an alleged Iranian plot on a UK airbase. The US also issued a Middle East security alert; the US mission in Saudi Arabia restricted airport travel for government employees amid missile/drone attacks on Saudi airports (Riyadh operations suspended, Jeddah/Dammam delays). (Illustrative 2017 MOAB stock photo used.)

items.title: Araghchi mocks Trump's 'finish the job' threat on X; accuses Netanyahu of pushing US into war
items.summary: Iranian FM Abbas Araghchi hit back on X (Monday Oct 19) at Trump's Truth Social endorsement of Netanyahu ahead of Israel's Oct 27 elections and Trump's warning the US would 'soon finish the job' unless Iran changed course: 'Last time you wanted to ‘finish the job’, Iran emerged even stronger. Want to try your luck again? Be our guest. But be careful, we have unfinished jobs too.' He accused Netanyahu of 'driving America into another war to stay out of jail.'

items.event_time_ist: Incident 1000 UTC Monday, Oct 19, 2026 (3:30 PM IST); reported Oct 20
items.title: UKMTO: tanker interacted with military forces ~121 nm east of Duqm, Oman
items.summary: UKMTO Advisory 178-26 (reported Tuesday Oct 20): a tanker was 'subject to interaction' with military forces about 121 nautical miles east of Duqm, Oman, at 1000 UTC Monday Oct 19, 'as part of ongoing military activity' in the region. Authorities are aware and investigations continue; UKMTO reported no damage or casualties and did not identify the vessel.
